items.quote: If you are a direct developer, meaning only you or your business accesses your own data, use a System User access token.
items.why: Says direct developers use a System User token; implies bearer but never names bearer_token or oauth2.

items.quote: you must implement Embedded Signup (configured with Facebook Login for Businesses)
items.why: Describes Tech Provider Embedded Signup; related to the auth flow but names no auth method.

items.quote: Click Generate access token to generate a temporary access token to send a test message.
items.why: Describes generating a temporary test token; says nothing about an admin approval gate.

items.quote: If not yet registered, visit the developer registration page and follow the prompts.
items.why: Self-serve registration prompt; if anything implies no approval gate, contrary to admin_approval.

items.quote: This connection allows your app to access the WhatsApp Cloud API and send messages on behalf of your business.
items.why: Confirms API access to send messages; does not state REST or breadth of coverage.

items.quote: This release is built for development and testing workflows, not production sending at scale.
items.why: Describes release scope (dev/testing, not production). Does not show MCP server exists or is vendor-official.
Shows the MCP server uses OAuth sign-in; supports that detail, not existence or vendor-official status.
